context.title: Trading context
map.search: Search terminal, hub, TSO, balancing point, field, source
map.route_corridors_only_body: PostgreSQL contains commercial route candidates, but no verified pipeline geometry. Candidate legs are rendered as dashed indicative corridors, never as physical pipelines.
map.unverified_geometry_body: Reference edges exist, but none includes verified, licence-approved line coordinates. Unverified route evidence is rendered as dashed indicative corridors and is never presented as physical pipeline geometry.
map.network_warning_body: The runtime database has reference nodes, but no verified reference_edges geometry. Network view currently shows source points plus dashed indicative corridors for backend route evidence.
map.runtime_missing_body: Runtime PostgreSQL is not connected. The map will not fabricate network, capacity, or route data.
map.nodes_missing_body: Runtime PostgreSQL is connected, but no reference nodes are loaded. Run public-source ingestion or customer data import.
map.coordinate_quality_note: Physical LNG, interconnection, and network points are displayed only with verified coordinates. Virtual market hubs may use representative market-area positions.
map.geometry_surveyed_metadata_only: metadata only; shown as an indicative corridor, not independently verified geometry.
map.geometry_indicative_warning: route topology evidence only, shown as an indicative schematic corridor, not surveyed pipeline geometry.
map.indicative_route_warning: Indicative schematic corridor; not surveyed or official pipeline geometry.
map.empty_title: No governed network evidence to display
map.empty_help: Load governed reference-network nodes, verified geometry, or route evidence to populate this map. The basemap remains visible, but Eurogas Nexus will not fabricate network features.
map.node_popup_approximate_coordinate: Approximate display coordinate, not surveyed WGS84 geometry.
map.unmatched_route_legs_warning: {{count}} route leg node(s) were not matched; map shows an indicative schematic corridor, not surveyed pipeline geometry.
map.source_derived_leg_sequence_warning: Matched route legs are shown as an indicative schematic corridor, not surveyed pipeline geometry.
map.source_derived_corridor_warning: Only source and target corridor evidence is available; shown as an indicative schematic corridor, not surveyed pipeline geometry.
map.direct_route_fallback_warning: No verified route geometry is available; the map draws an indicative schematic corridor between matched endpoints, not surveyed pipeline geometry.
map.network_ready_body: European network geometry and operating observations are loaded from PostgreSQL. Use Sources for provider diagnostics and Scenario for route economics.
home.pool_description: All purchase contracts feed one pool. The cockpit recommends sale paths, split capacity, and PnL attribution through backend API workflows.
home.reason_blocked: Blocked by missing input or access
home.draft_contract_note: Home waits for persisted customer contracts. Use Contracts to capture EFET-style terms, then store them through the backend.
home.path_unavailable: No persisted resource path is available yet.
home.run_pool_optimizer: Run resource-pool optimization to price all paths.
home.blocker_contracts: No persisted upstream contracts are loaded.
home.blocker_routes: No DB route candidates are loaded.
home.blocker_tariffs: No DB TSO tariff rows are loaded.
home.blocker_prices: No DB market price observations are loaded.
home.no_evidence_warnings: No active warnings or source gaps
home.optimization_scope: Compare persisted sale options, access rights, capacity limits and route economics; allocate only where the resulting margin is positive.
capacity.title: Capacity operations
capacity.subtitle: Monitor physical load against firm technical capacity, then inspect booking access and published tariff evidence for the selected point.
capacity.search_points: Search point, TSO, country, or direction
capacity.no_comparable_body: The latest ENTSOG physical-flow records do not currently match a firm technical-capacity record at the same point and direction. Capacity utilization is therefore unavailable; inspect source status before route decisions.
capacity.operating_board_note: Flow and firm technical capacity use the same point, direction, and standardized mcm/d basis.
capacity.no_matching_points: No operating points match the current filters.
capacity.storage_note: Facility inventory, fill and net injection or withdrawal observations from the backend runtime store.
capacity.lng_note: Terminal inventory, send-out and DTMI observations from the backend runtime store.
capacity.readiness_available: Published capacity observations indicate headroom. Company TSO access and executable booking availability still require confirmation.
capacity.readiness_constrained: Observed utilization is at or above 85%. Check alternative routes, products, and remaining capacity before using this point.
capacity.readiness_stale: The physical flow or firm technical capacity observation is older than 24 hours. Refresh the ENTSOG source before relying on this point.
capacity.readiness_incomplete: Flow and capacity observations cannot be compared. Do not infer available capacity until the missing source record is resolved.
market.title: Gas Market Terminal
market.subtitle: Terminal view for major European gas prices, regional spreads, FX references, and price-source posture. Positioning and PnL context are separated into Market Positioning.
market.live_exchange_prices: Exchange and broker feeds are shown when sourced from EEX, ICE OCM, Trayport, Platts, ICIS, Argus, or Kpler; the terminal does not fabricate missing prices.

strategy.warning.latest_intraday_outside: Latest intraday mark is outside the configured trading window
strategy.warning.strategy_run_not_persis: Strategy run could not be persisted
decision.preflight_help: The optimiser runs from the workspace's primary action; this panel reports what the run needs first and what it produced.
market.map_context_note: Map and numeric views are separate inspection tasks for the same market context: the map carries verified and indicative network geometry, while price evidence stays on the numeric market view.
market.no_relevant_resources: No relevant resources for the selected hub.

strategy_lab.save_draft_hint: Writes this draft: a new strategy and its first version, or an update to the editable version.

strategy_lab.blocker.in_flight: A strategy request is already in flight.

strategy_lab.shadow_checklist: State|Last evaluation|Next evaluation|Data freshness|Candidate observation|Risk checks|Blockers|Cumulative shadow indicative PnL|Recent evaluations|Backtest vs shadow drift

strategy_lab.warning.transaction_cost_un: Transaction cost is UNAVAILABLE and will not be subtracted.
strategy.no_registry_provenance: This is a legacy strategy-lab run without versioned registry provenance.

contracts.title: Resource Terms
contracts.description: Capture EFET-style resource terms and assumptions for portfolio decision support. This is not contract lifecycle management, settlement, or an ETRM master.
contracts.no_saved_contracts: No saved resource terms are loaded from PostgreSQL.
contracts.edit_confirm: Editing this persisted resource replaces the current unsaved draft.
contracts.selected_unavailable: The selected resource is not available in the loaded resource pool or resource library.
contracts.import_invalid: Imported file did not contain a contract record.
contracts.supported_formats: Supported formats: structured JSON and staged plain text. PDF and DOCX extraction are not enabled in this client.
contracts.section_help.agreement: Identify the operator-owned resource and its governing agreement assumptions.
contracts.section_help.product: Set the gas-year and pricing basis used to interpret this resource.
contracts.section_help.delivery: Record the commercial delivery and title-transfer points without implying verified physical topology.
contracts.section_help.quantity: Capture available daily volume and operational tolerances used by the pool model.
contracts.section_help.costs: All values are GBP/MWh. Variable and regas costs now flow into resource-pool economics.
contracts.section_help.capacity: Record only operator-confirmed capacity rights and access assumptions.
contracts.section_help.settlement: Cash timing drives financing value; these fields remain resource-specific.
contracts.section_help.restrictions: Allowed exits are enforced per resource. Sale modes are persisted for review until a formal candidate-mode mapping is implemented.
contracts.minimum_take_not_modeled: Minimum-take and take-or-pay obligations are not yet represented by the optimizer. Do not use this draft to assess those obligations.
contracts.validation.title: Validation
contracts.validation.complete: Required persistence fields are complete. Human review is still required.
contracts.validation.volume: Daily volume must be greater than zero.
contracts.validation.costs: Variable and regas costs cannot be negative.
contracts.validation.fuel_loss: Fuel loss must be between 0% and 100%.
contracts.impact_pending: Save valid terms to PostgreSQL before inspecting exact downstream pool impact.
contracts.boundary_note: Decision support only. Imports and changes do not create official contracts, execute trades, submit nominations, settle transactions, or update an ETRM.
sources.title: Data Source Center
sources.subtitle: Maintain provider categories, credentials, last-update status, diagnostics, and runtime record counts from backend-owned source posture.
sources.run.hint: Queues one manual ingestion run for the dataops worker; the worker executes it and the run list shows the outcome.
sources.run.blocker.runtime_db: Queuing a run needs a reachable runtime PostgreSQL: the queue is a persisted row.
sources.run.blocker.in_flight: A run request is already in flight.
sources.run.disclosure.credential_missin: The platform has no configured credential for this source, so a queued run has nothing to authenticate with.
sources.run.disclosure.circuit_open: This source's circuit is open: the platform is deliberately holding back automatic runs. A manual run is still queued, and it is recorded as operator-requested.
sources.run.disclosure.workflow_not_read: This source is not workflow-ready, so the run may complete without producing rows.
sources.run.disclosure.unreachable: The last connectivity check could not reach this source.
sources.run.disclosure.repeated_failures: This source has failed repeatedly; the run list shows each attempt and its failure category.
manual.title: Operating Manual
manual.subtitle: Customer-facing workspace guide for deploying and using Eurogas Nexus without mixing responsibilities across pages.
manual.network: Map-first resource-pool cockpit showing owned resources and recommended sale paths.
manual.capacity: Physical network, capacity, TSO access, tariff, storage, and LNG operating data.
manual.market: Price and FX observations, separated from positioning and PnL.
manual.contracts: EFET-style contract term capture feeding the portfolio resource pool.
manual.strategy: Backtest, shadow-run, and monitoring logic for user-defined strategies.
manual.review: Human review, warnings, route allocation evidence, and report generation.
manual.orders: Read-only market-positioning observations and live PnL snapshots imported through APIs.
manual.sources: Provider categories, credential maintenance, freshness, and diagnostics.
manual.boundary_copy: Eurogas Nexus is a DB-first decision-support product. Clients use SDK/API only; backend services own credentials, ingestion, validation, and persistence.
manual.api_only: Clients call the backend API/SDK only.
manual.no_execution: No trade execution, order routing, nomination submission, or official approval.
economics.compare_hint: Compares the sale options available to this identity and recommends an allocation.
economics.compare_blocked: Comparing needs a portfolio resource and at least one sale option in this context.
scenario.compare_location: The route comparison runs from this workspace's primary action in the Scenario task: one compute consequence, one control. The economics you edit here are the ones it sends.
scenario.optimizer_location: The pool optimiser runs from this workspace's primary action in the Optimize task: it is one compute consequence with one control, and the economics you edit here are the ones it sends.
glossary.context_empty: Select a term or request operational context to load current capacity, market, route, contract, and warning evidence.
analysis.invoke_deepseek: Invoke DeepSeek if backend credential is configured
review.report_help: Build the portfolio report from the data this identity is entitled to see. The report is a deterministic backend run; an AI-drafted document is the copilot's Draft action.
review.snapshot.label: Reproducibility reference
review.snapshot.record: Record this context as a snapshot
review.snapshot.record_hint: Freezes the Active Context this surface is showing as a reference a run can be reproduced against, and selects it for the next report.
review.snapshot.blocker.runtime_db: Recording a snapshot needs a reachable runtime PostgreSQL: a snapshot is persisted evidence, not a derived read.
review.snapshot.blocker.empty_context: There is no Active Context to freeze: a snapshot that names no version set is evidence of nothing.
review.snapshot.blocker.in_flight: A read or write is already in flight.
review.snapshot.help: The report cites the Analysis Snapshot you choose, so it can be reproduced against the same version set. The backend verifies the reference before the run.
review.snapshot.empty: No Analysis Snapshot is recorded yet, so this run can cite none. A snapshot is recorded from the Active Context through the platform API.
review.snapshot.not_configured: This deployment has no runtime database, so no Analysis Snapshot can be listed and this run cites none.

agents.title: Agent Research
agents.subtitle: Governed semantic capabilities, research orchestration, and observable agent replay.
agents.boundary: Research assistant boundary: no execution, no SQL, no hidden chain-of-thought.
capabilities.invoke_hint: Calls the selected capability under your own authority and shows the result the runtime returned.
capabilities.policy.human_only: Human only: never invoked from here
capabilities.confirm: I have reviewed the arguments and confirm this invocation.
capabilities.ready: Ready to invoke; the runtime still checks your permissions, data scopes and the arguments.
capabilities.blocker.human_only: This capability is declared human-only: the runtime never invokes it, so no confirmation unlocks it.
capabilities.blocker.arguments_invalid: The arguments must be a JSON object. Nothing is sent until they parse, so a mistyped editor cannot invoke a capability with inputs you did not write.
capabilities.blocker.confirmation_requir: This capability requires your confirmation before it runs.
capabilities.blocker.in_flight: An invocation is already in flight.
agents.objective_placeholder: Describe the market question or hypothesis to investigate.
agents.allow_strategy: Allow deterministic Strategy IR drafting when evidence supports it.
agents.run_research_hint: Starts a governed research run and records it in the run list.
agents.readiness.title: Run readiness
agents.blocker.runtime_db: A reachable runtime PostgreSQL is required: a research run persists its plan, findings and job record.
agents.blocker.objective_short: The objective must be at least 8 characters for the research runtime to plan from.
agents.blocker.objective_long: The objective must be at most 4000 characters.
agents.blocker.in_flight: A research run is already in flight.
agents.strategy.off: Strategy generation not requested: this run reports findings only.
agents.strategy.human_confirmation_requi: Requesting strategy generation drafts a candidate only: freezing a StrategyVersion and backtesting it are human acts, so the run stops for human confirmation.
agents.strategy.no_frozen_version: This surface sends no frozen StrategyVersion, so a generation run cannot reach a backtest here.
agents.scope.disclosure: Planned analyses are validated against your own data scopes before they run; a missing entitlement blocks the run and appears in its blockers.
agents.profile.recorded: The run profile is recorded by the research runtime and shown on the run record; this surface does not choose it.
agents.chain_help: Ordered, persisted CR-15 artifacts of this run. Each entry reports the operation that produced it, its artifact identity, replay and fixture identity, lineage, entitlement state and timestamps. Reading this chain is evidence only: it executes nothing.
agents.chain_progress_help: Persisted artifacts in the six-stage chain
agents.artifact_absent_help: This artifact is absent from the run, so no body, lineage or entitlement state exists for it.
agents.artifact_body_unavailable: The chain lists this artifact as present, but this read carried no body for it, so nothing is rendered for it.
agents.deterministic_yes: Yes, the replay identity is content-addressed
agents.payload_absent: No payload is persisted for this artifact.
agents.hidden_cot_none: Not applicable: nothing hidden is stored. The replay payload returns hidden_chain_of_thought as null for the run and for every artifact, so no reasoning text is rendered here.
agents.plan.question: Plan question
agents.gate.title: Human review gate
agents.gate.help: Record the reviewer verdict for the persisted review pack through the existing review-decision endpoint. The decision is stored with the reviewer identity and the time it was recorded, then read back from the backend.
agents.gate.unavailable_no_pack: No persisted review pack exists for this run, so no human decision can be recorded against it.
agents.gate.unavailable_no_id: The review pack carries no persisted artifact ID, so no decision can be recorded against it.
agents.gate.unavailable_no_identity: No authenticated reviewer identity is available, so no decision can be attributed and recorded.
agents.gate.note_placeholder: Optional note stored with the decision.
agents.gate.submit_hint: Recording a decision stores the reviewer verdict and an audit event. It does not execute, schedule or nominate anything.
agents.gate.refusal_unknown_kind: The backend refused this decision because the review artifact kind is outside the controlled vocabulary, which answers HTTP 422. Nothing was recorded.
agents.gate.refusal_identity: The backend refused this decision because the reviewer identity is missing or not privileged to review, which answers HTTP 401 or 403. Nothing was recorded.
agents.gate.refusal_failed: The backend refused this decision, so nothing was recorded. Check the reviewer session and the persisted review pack before retrying.
agents.gate.boundary: Governed boundary: this gate records a human verdict on persisted evidence only, and the chain above stays read-only evidence.
agents.gate.no_decisions: No human decision is recorded for this review pack yet.

data_product.provenance.unmeasured: Not measured: no runtime database is configured for this deployment.
data_product.empty: No Data Product is declared by this deployment.

research.target_registry_help: Forecast/evaluation targets; targets are never features.

research.select_dataset_help: Choose a snapshot to inspect its provenance, quality, and export reference policy.
research.export_reference_help: Requests the backend artifact reference. This does not download a file.
research.export_unknown_policy: Export is unavailable because the backend policy is unknown.
research.export_restricted_policy: Export is unavailable because the dataset policy is restricted.
research.export_denied_backend: Backend denied this export under the dataset entitlement policy (403).
research.request_error: The research data request could not be completed.
research.unauthorized_error: Research data access requires an authenticated session.
research.forbidden_error: Research data access is forbidden for the current identity.
research.catalog_error: Some research catalog data could not be loaded.
research.detail_error: The selected dataset detail could not be loaded.
research.export_error: The artifact reference could not be requested.
research.spec_build_help: Validate the spec before it can be built.
research.spec_build_note: Only the values you type are sent; the backend applies its own documented defaults. Every feature, target, entity, and policy id is resolved against the canonical registry, so a spec that names something this deployment has not registered is reported as an issue instead of being built.
research.spec_placeholder_frequency: Positive integer with h or d, for example 1d
research.spec_placeholder_output_format: Row layout; the backend defaults to long
research.spec_required_note: Fields marked with an asterisk have no backend default and must be typed.
research.build_hint: Builds the dataset snapshot this validated spec describes and records the run.
research.build_locked_not_validated: Build stays locked until this exact spec passes validation.
research.build_locked_spec_changed: The spec changed after validation. Validate it again to unlock build.
research.build_locked_validation_failed: Build stays locked while validation reports issues.
research.build_unlocked: Validation passed for this spec; build is unlocked.
research.validation_not_run: This spec has not been validated yet.
research.validation_no_issues: The backend reported no structured issues.
research.build_not_run: No build has been attempted from this workspace.
research.build_rejected_help: The structured issues are the authoritative reason; adjust the spec and validate again.
research.build_created_help: The snapshot catalog below was refreshed and the new snapshot is selected.
research.build_error: The build request could not be completed.
research.build_forbidden: The current identity is not entitled to the sources this spec requires (403).
research.build_formats_unreported: The build answer does not list artifact formats; select the created snapshot to read the formats the backend has registered.
research.build_formats_reported: Formats reported by the build answer are listed above.
research.entitlement_allowed: Export allowed by canonical source policy
research.entitlement_restricted: Export refused by canonical source policy
research.entitlement_unknown: Export policy could not be derived
research.export_unknown_explanation: No canonical policy was recorded for this snapshot, so the workspace fails closed and offers no artifact control.
research.export_restricted_explanation: Delivery rights are derived from the canonical provenance of the sources this snapshot was built from, and this deployment does not grant export clearance for them. The backend therefore refuses every format with 403 while keeping the reference server-side. This is the governed state of the deployment, not a fault in this dataset, and no download is offered.
research.export_no_registered_format: No artifact format the backend accepts is registered for this snapshot, so no reference can be requested.
research.export_answer_restricted: The backend refused this request under the source entitlement policy (403). The reference stays server-side and no download is available.
research.export_answer_format_unregister: The backend holds no stored artifact in the requested format (409, FORMAT_NOT_REGISTERED).
research.export_answer_file_missing: The registered artifact is no longer present in backend storage (409, FILE_MISSING). Rebuilding the snapshot is the only way to restore it.
research.export_answer_unavailable: The backend did not return an artifact reference for this request.
research.export_reference_only: This is a governed reference; the artifact itself stays server-side.

errors.family.AUTH.title: Sign-in or role problem
errors.family.AUTH.impact: No data was changed. The requested surface stays unavailable until the session or role is fixed.
errors.family.AUTH.action: Sign in again, or ask an administrator for the role this action needs.
errors.family.ENTITLEMENT.title: Data entitlement restriction
errors.family.ENTITLEMENT.impact: The restricted values stay hidden; unaffected surfaces keep working.
errors.family.ENTITLEMENT.action: Request the entitlement or a commercial role for this data family.
errors.family.VALIDATION.title: Input needs correction
errors.family.VALIDATION.impact: Nothing was saved, so the current draft is unchanged.
errors.family.VALIDATION.action: Correct the highlighted field and submit again.
errors.family.DATA.title: Data quality problem
errors.family.DATA.impact: Figures shown may be stale or incomplete until new data arrives.
errors.family.DATA.action: Check the data status and last verified time before acting on these values.
errors.family.CALCULATION.title: The calculation has no feasible answer
errors.family.CALCULATION.impact: No result was produced; previous results are untouched.
errors.family.CALCULATION.action: Relax a constraint or assumption and run again.
errors.family.DEPENDENCY.title: A dependency is unavailable
errors.family.DEPENDENCY.impact: Only the affected slice is missing; other panels keep their last good values.
errors.family.DEPENDENCY.action: Retry shortly; if it persists, quote the correlation id to an operator.
errors.family.CONFIGURATION.title: Deployment configuration problem
errors.family.CONFIGURATION.impact: This capability cannot work until the deployment is configured.
errors.family.CONFIGURATION.action: An operator must complete the deployment configuration.
errors.family.JOB.title: Background job problem
errors.family.JOB.impact: The job stopped; its partial output is not treated as a result.
errors.family.JOB.action: Retry the job, or review its last error with an operator.
errors.family.AGENT.title: AI capability problem
errors.family.AGENT.impact: No AI output was recorded; deterministic results are unaffected.
errors.family.AGENT.action: Retry with a narrower objective, or continue without the AI action.
errors.family.SYSTEM.title: Unexpected system error
errors.family.SYSTEM.impact: The request did not complete and no partial result is trusted.
errors.family.SYSTEM.action: Retry once, then quote the correlation id to an operator.
errors.cause.session_missing: No session was presented for this request.
errors.cause.session_expired: The session ended or was revoked.
errors.cause.role_insufficient: This role does not cover the requested surface.
errors.cause.capability_missing: The identity lacks the capability this action needs.
errors.cause.licence_restriction: The data licence does not cover this principal.
errors.cause.administration_is_not_comme: Platform administration does not grant commercial data access.
errors.cause.self_grant_refused: Roles and data scopes are granted by someone else; an identity cannot change its own.
errors.cause.export_restriction: Export is restricted for this dataset.
errors.cause.data_beyond_freshness: The newest value is older than the freshness expectation.
errors.cause.source_has_no_rows: The source returned no rows for this selection.
errors.cause.snapshot_out_of_date: The snapshot this result was computed on is out of date.
errors.cause.constraints_block_route: A constraint makes this route infeasible.
errors.cause.no_feasible_allocation: No allocation satisfies the current constraints.
errors.cause.provider_unreachable: The provider connection did not answer.
errors.cause.runtime_store_unreachable: The runtime store could not be reached.
errors.cause.agent_budget_reached: The AI run reached its configured budget.
errors.cause.job_step_failed: A job step failed before producing output.
errors.unclassified.message: The request failed and the cause is not classified.
errors.unclassified.action: Retry once, then quote the correlation id to an operator.
errors.family.AUTH.cause: The request was not accepted as an authenticated, authorised caller.
errors.family.ENTITLEMENT.cause: The data licence or entitlement does not cover this request.
errors.family.VALIDATION.cause: The submitted input did not pass validation.
errors.family.DATA.cause: The underlying data is missing, stale or incomplete.
errors.family.CALCULATION.cause: The deterministic engine found no feasible answer for these inputs.
errors.family.DEPENDENCY.cause: An external or internal dependency did not answer.
errors.family.CONFIGURATION.cause: The deployment is missing configuration this action requires.
errors.family.JOB.cause: A background job did not complete.
errors.family.AGENT.cause: The governed AI capability could not complete the request.
decision_case.blocker.evidence_required: Evidence is required before a decision can be recorded.
decision_case.blocker.snapshot_recommend: No analysis snapshot is attached, so the decision cannot be reproduced from the case alone.
decision_case.blocker.decided_case_requi: A decided case must carry its decision record.
decision_case.blocker.unknown: The case cannot be decided yet.
decision_case.title: Decision cases
decision_case.subtitle: Objective, context, evidence and the human decision record
decision_case.objective_placeholder: Describe the decision and its deadline
decision_case.empty: No case in this view yet.
decision_case.boundary: A decision record is evidence and rationale owned by a named human. It is not an instruction to execute anything.
decision_case.error_generic: The decision case request did not complete.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics bundle
diagnostics.subtitle: Support evidence composed from an allowlist: versions, host, language, data status, endpoint failure codes, degraded slices and job states.
diagnostics.unavailable_hint: Declared fields this client had no fact for. They are omitted rather than sent as a zero, which would read like a measurement.
diagnostics.guarantee: The bundle is composed from a declared allowlist, and a field declared both allowed and forbidden is a hard error, so no credential, token or commercial value can enter it.
diagnostics.handover.download: The bundle leaves this client as a file download.
diagnostics.handover.native_export_pendi: This desktop host declares a native diagnostics export, but that command is not implemented in this build.
diagnostics.message.copy_failed: This browser refused clipboard access; download the bundle instead.

experience.palette.unavailable_evidence: Select an object to attach as evidence first
experience.copilot.title: Copilot
experience.copilot.subtitle: Interpretation and drafting over the data this identity is already entitled to see
experience.copilot.boundary: The copilot inherits your authority and never widens entitlement. It interprets, explains, compares, challenges and drafts. Deterministic engines own every calculation, and it cannot execute a trade, enter an order, submit a nomination or settle anything.
experience.copilot.context_complete: The active context carries what an AI action needs.
experience.copilot.context_incomplete: The active context is incomplete, so no AI action is offered.
experience.copilot.context_reproducible: This context is reproducible from the snapshot reference the run reports.
experience.copilot.context_not_reproduci: This context is not reproducible from the context alone: no analysis snapshot is attached to it yet, so the run reports the snapshot the backend actually used.
experience.copilot.gap.organization: Organisation scope is not modelled yet
experience.copilot.gap.portfolio: Portfolio scope is not modelled yet
experience.copilot.gap.analysis-snapshot: No analysis snapshot is attached to this context
experience.copilot.evidence_none: No evidence reference is selected, so every AI action is withheld. Select a route, a resource, a strategy version or a run first.
experience.copilot.produces.ask: A sourced answer that names the data it used and states what it could not see.
experience.copilot.produces.explain: An explanation bound to the run, snapshot and assumption set it describes.
experience.copilot.produces.compare: A side-by-side reading that names the basis of comparison and any missing input.
experience.copilot.produces.challenge: A challenge record that stays evidence-linked and human-owned.
experience.copilot.produces.draft: A draft marked as unverified until a named human accepts or edits it.
experience.copilot.withheld_context: Withheld: the active context is incomplete
experience.copilot.withheld_evidence: Withheld: no evidence reference is selected
experience.copilot.question: What this action should answer
experience.copilot.question_placeholder: State the question the run should answer
experience.copilot.question_default: Leave empty to run the action with its contract framing.
experience.copilot.result_interpretation: Interpretation, not a calculation: this output is decision support for a named human reviewer.
experience.copilot.result_numeric_author: No figure in this output is an authority. Deterministic engines own calculations, optimisation and PnL truth.
experience.copilot.provider_invoked: The provider answered, so the text below is its interpretation of the snapshot it was given.
experience.copilot.provider_not_invoked: The provider was not invoked, so the text below is the deterministic backend summary rather than a model interpretation.
experience.copilot.error_title: The AI action did not complete
experience.inspector.unresolved: Detail for this selection is not resolved in this build. The reference and the page it came from are shown instead.
